name: kate-edger-information-commons
estimated: round 0: every roof drawn flat at its median (their falls, parapets and plant left out); the end over the court drawn down to the ground; the atrium's glazed roof (from the few returns along it) and its glazed end; the ground (provisional, until door is set); the colours of every wall and roof
refs_note: the folder of refs/ that holds the reference views (views.json, masks/), which refine, compare, metrics, sky_mask and the viewer's ?sv= read: refs/photos (gitignored), whose views tools/photo_camera.py writes

building.title: Kate Edger Information Commons, University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 315's outer ring from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; it chooses the crop box and the building's own points (frame.near_outline, measure and topview). The site replaces block 315 by its id.

origin.note: the campus origin, as in campus.json; the landmark's local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, with grid north

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) more than min_above m above the ground and within near_outline m of building.outline

ground_note: provisional: the median LiDAR ground (class 2) in the crop box (p5 38.0, p95 45.2: the site falls about 7 m); set to the ground at the door at step 7
